observable_behavior: SDK-only public input: ModelsStore read/write/delete、refresh baseURL、显式 personalize_openrouter_catalog、Radius dynamic 空列表、schema/version fixtures、stale publish. Apply all source row evidence boundaries and later backend/RDF refinements. Host-impact clauses do not grant host delivery.

observable_behavior: SDK-only public input: 模型 defaults、effective effort override、request sampling；catalog pricing tiers＋usage、image/media/token 输入限制；native/simple. Observable result and failure: sampling 按 model defaults→effective-level map→request keys 逐键覆盖，只给真实支持的 OpenAI-compatible APIs 应用；simple 先 resolve effort/native 不偷 clamp，named 与 arbitrary keys 优先级可观察。calculateCost/helper消费adapter的最高命中 **strict > threshold** tier 对整次请求收费（实际matchedThreshold起始-1，仅threshold>-1入选、同threshold保留首项；负阈值不新增准入拒绝），OpenRouter image parseUsage保留基价、不取tiers；同model基价input=1、tier input=2且超过阈值时image用1/helper用2，阈值基数 input+cacheRead+cacheWrite、等于/超过、缺/0/invalid/溢出均测；unknown price/usage 不补可靠0，负 placeholder 按显式 Rust unknown 差异且无负费用。Responses serviceTier按response优先/request后备；flex0.5、priority/fast为2（model ID恰gpt-5.5为2.5）、其余1；Codex HTTP/WS的fast为1，response default保留request flex/priority，其他沿response优先；Azure无倍率。倍率乘已知四成本bucket后合计，unknown保留；fixtures含default/省略/覆盖/精确模型ID，不能仅测发送tier。3.5 estimator 与 V-45 单一算法；inputLimits（maxRequestBytes、images maxPerMessage/maxPerRequest、resize maxWidth/maxHeight/maxBytes/jpegQuality）按原schema和Serde保留，Pi SDK没有该统一runtime执行点，不新增默认pre-dispatch cap或resize；选择该政策的宿主/显式caller才验执行。model modality真实拒绝保留，不套四MIME/container假硬限制 Gemini4+源码regex、Xiaomi off/high toggle和Codex500000为generator/changed-test事实；无hydrated目录不得报catalog通过。. Apply all source row evidence boundaries and later backend/RDF refinements. Host-impact clauses do not grant host delivery.

observable_behavior: Model/options/cost owners; select effort/ingest metadata. MUST map per-effective-thinking-level sampling with model base < effective level < request precedence, operation input-limit metadata, compat and request-wide pricing tiers. For calculateCost/helper-consuming adapters, with matchedThreshold=-1 and eligible thresholds>-1, the highest strictly exceeded input+cache-read+cache-write threshold applies to the whole request; equal duplicate thresholds keep the first entry; OpenRouter image parseUsage instead retains base model.cost rates without tiers, an explicit source exception; preserve 1h subsets without double count. Preserve response-sensitive service-tier multipliers and the distinct Responses/Codex default/fast resolution in the SDK annex; Azure has no such multiplier. Preserve source-defined metadata field validity/rates and distinguish unknown from zero; metadata alone does not authorize a new SDK pre-dispatch limit or resize; catalog placeholder-price treatment is an explicit RDF difference. Related active V and current source/RDF qualify complete acceptance, host references remain excluded.

observable_behavior: SDK-only public input: 公开显式 retry_assistant_call(owned produce, optional policy, cancel, callbacks)；transient/busy/upstream/stalled、quota/billing/overflow/abort、partial usage. Observable result and failure: 无 policy/disabled/0 只调用 produce 一次；enabled 至多1+max_retries 个**新 logical calls**，单一指数 delay/base/cap，不串接旧流、不执行工具、不主动切换 provider/model/account、不隐式 session；任意 produce 闭包的目标由 caller 负责，若使用 Models 受控 call factory 则执行冻结目标/来源身份检查。配额/billing/overflow/abort/auth 与配置错误不重试；typed 新分类覆盖 Pi1.3 transient/stalled及gateway/temporarily-unavailable，不靠泄漏原 body 匹配。scheduled 在 sleep 前、attempt-start 在 sleep 后且新 call 前；finished 有重试时只一次，有效 Ok 的 Stop/Length/ToolUse/Deferred 对应 true，Error/Aborted 为 false；这不授予工具执行或 remote ready 许可。取消 delay 为 Err/Aborted 保留最近 partial/usage，零后续 produce/timer。callback 失败 typed 结束，不重跑 callback/业务、不吞；与低层 acquisition/strict variant/WS budget 独立可计数，返回 failure 不虚构完整重试账单 新增Unable to forward upstream stream与The service is temporarily unavailable匹配，保留quota/overflow/auth/abort排除和默认次数不变。. Apply all source row evidence boundaries and later backend/RDF refinements. Host-impact clauses do not grant host delivery.
